segments.title: Web apps show their unread count on their tab
segments.body: A pinned mail app, a pinned chat and an open forum whose titles pick up unread counts. nightly.2 only changed the title; now the count sits on the icon, in Top Apps, pinned rows and ordinary tabs alike.

segments.title: Links from pinned tabs open in a Peek
segments.body: "Open a Peek window when clicking on links to other sites" is on in both. A link in a pinned mail app that opens a new tab, as Gmail's do: nightly.2 opened a tab; now it opens in a Peek, and the app's tile wears the Peek's icon.

segments.title: The command bar pulses in the site's colour
segments.body: ⌘T, then "bing" and Tab to search Bing from the command bar. Both enter the search; now the bar pulses in Bing's teal and keeps a faint tint while the search is on.

segments.title: The page frame goes down to edge to edge
segments.body: The new Page Frame setting, a slider in Settings › Appearance, stepped from 9 pt to 0. nightly.2 had no such setting and always kept the 9 pt frame; now the page can run to the window's edges.

segments.title: Bookmarks can hide, and Copy URL takes the star's place
segments.body: Show bookmarks off, then a hover on the address bar and a click where the bookmark button was. nightly.2 had no such switch and kept the button; now Copy URL sits there and copies the clean link.

segments.title: Shared Top Apps stay put when you switch spaces
segments.body: Two spaces that share Top Apps, and ⌃2 to Work. nightly.2 slid the shared tiles out and back in with the space; now they hold still and only the tabs below them move.

segments.title: A pinned tab away from its page shows "/ title"
segments.body: A pinned Notes row, then a click into one of its notes. nightly.2 showed only the new page's title; now a dimmed "/" before it says the pinned tab has left its address, as Arc does.

segments.title: A click that drifts a few points still counts
segments.body: Two clicks on sidebar tabs where the pointer drifts 4 to 5 points before it lets go. nightly.2 read them as tiny drags and stayed on Docpad; now each one opens its tab.

segments.title: The selected tab stands out on a near-black profile
segments.body: A custom near-black profile, clicking down the tab list with the pointer moved off each time. nightly.2 drew the selected tab darker than the sidebar, so it barely showed; now it gets a lighter fill that stands out.
